name: Paris School of Business

about.text: Paris School of Business is a highly prestigious business school established in 1972. It was originally known as the ESG Management School in Paris, France, but was renamed in 2015. Paris School of Business offers a broad spectrum of Bachelor’s, master’s, and Doctorate courses in business management and executive master’s and doctorate courses for business professionals. All the courses are imparted through the different departments of the institute.

Paris School of Business is known for its focus on Art, design, and Technology. It combines interdisciplinary skills and multicultural experiences to provide high quality education. The institute aims to train students to prepare them for leadership roles in international companies. The emphasis on leadership, management, and intercultural communication equips students to address complex problems in the contemporary global economy.

The academic programs at the Paris School of Business are supported by excellent professors and researchers. The faculty members of the institute cover all the areas of management with academic excellence, innovation, and social responsibility. With 52% percent of faculty members from top international universities, it provides high quality education with a global perspective. Paris School of Business is a member of the European Foundation for Management Development (EFMD) and the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB).

Paris School of Business has strategic partnerships with leading global companies and prestigious academic institutions. This partnership is highly beneficial for offering cutting-edge research, and helping students to become skilled and forward-thinking professionals. Students are prepared to excel in the diverse business landscape with highly rewarding opportunities.

aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

emi.text: Students enrolled in the Paris School of Business get a wide range of scholarships and financial aid to support their education. The Crous State Scholarship, Paris School of Business social scholarship, Paris School of Business merit-based scholarship, and Erasmus scholarship are major scholarships available to the students. Students can also apply for State-guaranteed loan to fund their education.

admission.text: Admission to the Paris School of Business is conducted can be completed online. The admission process involves several steps. Here are the steps for admission to the Paris School of Business-
Application File - This is the first step in the admission process. Applicants interested in admission must fill out the application file. It can be filled out online with the steps mentioned below:
Step 1- Visit the official website of the Paris School of Business.
Step 2- Navigate to the admission option and choose the program.
Step 3- Click on the apply online option and choose registration.
Step 4- Generate login credentials and click on the login button.
Step 5- Login using the credentials generated.
Step 6- Fill out the details required by the institution and attract required documents.
Step 7- Review the application file for any errors and submit it.
Step 8- Proceed for the payment of application fees.
Step 9- Choose the payment method and pay the application fees.
Step 10- Save and take a printout of the acknowledgment slip for future reference.

Application Analysis - Once the application file has been submitted, it will be analyzed by the admission committee of the Paris School of Business. It will check whether the application file has the following information and documents:
Completed application file
ID photo
Photocopy of official ID
Photocopies of diplomas and reports obtained from baccalaureate level onwards (certified and translated into French for documents in another language)
CV + cover letter
100 euros administrative fee (reduced to 50 euros for scholarship students, subject to producing the definitive scholarship certificate for the academic year in progress

Individual Interview - The application file with all the required documents will be shortlisted by the admission committee. Selected applicants will be called for the individual interview. The interview can be conducted on-site, by telephone, or by videoconference.

Admission Offer - Based on the application file and individual interview, applicants will receive an admission offer from the Paris School of Business. Applicant can secure their admission by paying the admission fees.

examination.text: The examination pattern at Paris School of Business differs based on course levels. For undergraduate and postgraduate courses, students have to appear for written tests and complete group and individual projects and assignments. For doctorate courses, students are assessed based on coursework, comprehensive examination, original research, and viva voice.
